verdict.rationale: Stripe exposes a comprehensive, well-documented REST API with idempotency, restricted keys, versioning, sandboxes, webhooks, OpenAPI-generated SDKs, and CLI/Workbench tooling, and this is independently corroborated by a probe confirming the API and llms.txt are live and reachable. missing for 10: no independent third-party benchmark of raw API completeness beyond docs/probes, and OpenAPI spec discovery via well-known paths returned 404s per stripe-probe-3.
